flight_vacuum — DRIVE ball op

• Data kinds: signal → points

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.flight_vacuum(p0, v0, t, g: 'float' = 9.81) -> 'np.ndarray' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import ballistics; ballistics.flight_vacuum(p0, v0, t, g: 'float' = 9.81) -> 'np.ndarray', registry से लेना हो तो opsdrive.get("flight_vacuum"))

उपयोग

vacuum में parabola (closed form): p(t) = p₀ + v₀ t − ½ g t² ẑ। t scalar या (N,) है, return value (3,) या (N, 3)।
